title: Launch cadence forecasting hub and decision simulator
creator: Lena Park
description: Build a Lightweight Forecasting Hub and Decision Simulator to help PMs and Eng leads evaluate release-train timing, capacity hedges, and rollback thresholds across runtime, console, and API surfaces. The tool will model token-based throughput, regional capacity constraints, canary cohort size, and business OKR impact to propose launch windows and automated contingency lanes.
acceptance_criteria: A web-accessible forecasting dashboard that ingests planned release dates, estimated token volumes, and capacity reservations for runtime, console, and API by region.
Simulator can run at least three scenarios (nominal, degraded capacity, traffic spike) and output suggested cohort sizes, throttles, and rollback triggers.
Integration with existing capacity data (Dedicated reservations API) to show live capacity vs. requested capacity with delta alerts.
Exportable launch recommendation artifact (JSON) that includes proposed canary window, cohort sizing, and a preflight checklist link.
Stakeholder sign-off flow so PMs can publish recommended window into the launch calendar with a single click.
Basic what-if comparison report generated for two competing launches showing contention risk and suggested shifts.
Internal doc (PRD) and demo recorded for launch ops and infra teams.
comments: 2026-03-01 - Lena Park: Kickoff — draft PRD attached. Goal is to reduce launch coordination time and reduce last-minute capacity conflicts.
2026-03-03 - Miguel Alvarez: Initial scope proposal — MVP will not automate reallocation, only surface recommended shifts and generate artifacts for approvals.
2026-03-05 - Priya Nair: SRE caveat — we can expose Dedicated reservation state but need a read-only tokened view for the dashboard. Will create ENG-5099 for access layer.
2026-03-08 - Noah Kim: Design review — suggested heatmap visualization for conflict windows and a compact export format for runbooks.
2026-03-10 - Erika Soto: Launch Ops feedback — must include a 'week-of-go-live burnbox' flag and an automatic checklist link for escalation contacts.

2026-03-12 - Miguel Alvarez: Spike completed for scenario runner. Early results show the model can simulate 500+ concurrent launch permutations in ~45s on staging infra. Need decision on whether to include console telemetry in MVP.
decisions: Simulator will operate as a read-only advisory tool for the first 2 quarters; no automated capacity reallocation in MVP.
Include runtime, console, and API surfaces in the same simulation model but expose toggleable surface selection in UI.
MVP scenario set: nominal (expected), degradation (-25% capacity), spike (+150% traffic) — further scenarios to be added post-launch.
Export artifact schema will follow existing launch calendar JSON contract to allow one-click publish into calendar service.
Security: dashboard will require SSO; Dedicated reservation data surfaced via a service account with minimal privileges (SRE to onboard).
